# Format properties: AI visuals

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Decomposition tree, Key influencers, Narrative, Q&A), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/ai-visuals.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Decomposition tree | `decompositionTreeVisual` | 6 | 40 |
| Key influencers | `keyDriversVisual` | 3 | 12 |
| Narrative | `aiNarratives` | 2 | 5 |
| Q&A | `qnaVisual` | 0 | 0 |
